lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern; anterior clusters exhibit larger pixel area and greater inter-blob distance, while posterior clusters show increased spatial density and reduced individual diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a series of grid-like anchor nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient consisting of a high-luminance upper edge and a lower-luminance shadow immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains internal high-luminance blobs, though they are characterized by higher pixel blur and lower contrast relative to the primary lateral flank patterning.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, high-contrast white V-shaped or chevron-shaped mark is visible on the distal tip of the left pectoral fin.
